name: Veshant Dahiya
text: Peaceful retreat! Friendly hosts, clean rooms, and a beautiful location. Felt like home.

name: Sonali Bhardwaj
text: Wonderful stay! Cozy room, great hospitality, and delicious homemade food. Highly recommend!

name: Harsh
text: Lovely room, friendly hosts, and great breakfast. Quiet location but close to everything. Highly recommend!

name: Rahul Khanna
text: The place is perfect for a getaway. Peaceful atmosphere and great service.

name: Mansi Sharma
text: Super clean rooms and fantastic hosts. Would love to visit again.
